## Experiment

Repeats [`coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-8-flash-flash-saturation-low`](../coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-8-flash-flash-saturation-low/summary.md) (two agents with messaging and a shared git remote, `gemini-3.8-flash` at `low` thinking, 500 steps, compaction at 64K tokens, step counter, `$40` per-agent cost cap, 50-pair `flash` subset) through Vertex AI instead of AI Studio. It is the `coop --git` reference for later Vertex AI runs, including intervention arms, and a second measurement of the `coop --git` score on these pairs.

## Observations

- 30/50 (60%), the same score as the AI Studio run. Pair by pair, 28 passed in both runs, 2 passed only here (`pallets_jinja_task/1621` (4,5), `pillow_task/290` (3,5)), and 2 only on AI Studio (`dottxt_ai_outlines_task/1655` (6,7), `dottxt_ai_outlines_task/1706` (5,8)).
- Against `solo` with the same setup on Vertex AI (32/50): 4 pairs passed only here and 6 only in `solo`. Averaged over the two runs of each, `solo` scores about 34/50 and `coop --git` 30/50, a gap of about 4 pairs.
- Five pairs that `solo` solved in at least one run failed in both `coop --git` runs: `pallets_click_task/2068` (6,7) and (7,10), `pallets_click_task/2800` (2,7), `pallets_click_task/2956` (1,8), and `dspy_task/8394` (3,5). The two `2068` pairs again show agents working around a line both features need to change.
- Merges: 41 clean, 7 identical branches, 2 conflicts. No agent reached the 500-step limit; pairs exchanged a median of 30 messages.
- This run ran at 5 pairs at a time during US business hours. Five pairs got a false notice that the partner agent was no longer running, because a slow model call outlasted the agent's 10-minute liveness signal; 2 of those pairs failed (`dspy_task/8394` (3,5), `dottxt_ai_outlines_task/1706` (5,8)). See notes/model_config.md for the peak-hour concurrency guidance this led to.
